description: Verify a receipt offline: its Ed25519 signature against the bundled canlicapital.com key, its output hash and its id. Send an id to fetch it first, or the receipt itself. The receipt is content-hashed, reproducible from the open-source core it names, and signed with Ed25519 by a key published at https://canlicapital.com/.well-known/canli-receipt-keys.json.

id.description: Receipt id from a validation result.

include_receipt.description: With id: also return the stored receipt.

receipt.description: A receipt object, to verify without fetching.

name: verify_receipt

outputSchema.description: valid is true only when the signature, output hash and content id all check out; checks lists each.

title: Verify a receipt
